name: Marmosket V2
summary:
Dive into the wild and exhilarating world of Marmosket! Channel your inner marmoset as you swing through lush treetops, explore vast canopies, and discover hidden secrets in this immersive Gorilla Tag fan game. Whether you're looking to hang out with friends, conquer your fears in thrilling horror modes, or shop for the coolest gear, Marmosket has it all.

Features:

Tree-Swinging Fun: Experience the thrill of swinging from tree to tree with fluid and dynamic movement.
